brief:
African communities maintain cultural presence in Jerusalem's Old City despite militarization and occupation, according to reporting in The Guardian. The piece documents how African cultural traditions persist within the historic quarter, drawing on firsthand observation of the community's experience.

The report suggests African Palestinians navigate layers of institutional and physical barriers while preserving cultural identity in a contested urban space. The Guardian's account frames this persistence as notable given the documented challenges facing marginalized populations in occupied territories.

title: African culture endures in occupied Jerusalem despite marginalization
